generate_blender_headers: run the script to auto generate C++ header files for Blender serialization from DataTypeList
generate_blender_common_header: run the script to generate blender_Common.h with forward declarations for all Blender classes
generate_per_type_headers: run the script to generate individual C++ header files per data type with class definitions
addSpaces: use addSpaces to write a specified number of space characters to a file object for indentation
write: use write to write an indented string to a file object with a given number of leading spaces
